lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately vertical columns posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that coincide with the spatial positioning of the spot clusters, forming a lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges showing a light-to-dark vertical luminance gradient running parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis across the lateral flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant amorphous pale patch of depigmentation or epidermal trauma on the lower anterior snout/jaw region.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small teleost fish (remoras) visible along the ventral surface.
